findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:176 WHY: The Normal Story Path still places milestone_ledger_set and ledger sizing before understanding_set / intent_collision_set, while the updated decision text says pre-collision ledgers are only candidate ledgers and become gate-consumed after accepted intent interpretation. This leaves the plan internally inconsistent about when the ledger becomes gate-consumed. Severity: medium.
findings.resolvedReason: Normal Story Path now marks milestone_ledger_set as candidate only, moves understanding_set and intent_collision_set before confirmation, then runs intent_coverage_check and ledger sizing on the confirmed milestone ledger. Verified by rg for candidate-only, accepted interpretation confirmation, and confirmed ledger sizing.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:519 defines milestone_intent.requiredArtifacts as milestoneLedger plus intentCoverageCheck without an accepted-interpretation or confirmed-ledger binding, while docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:856 makes the ProofStory gate consume a generic milestone ledger and only requires intent collision when separately triggered. That leaves a candidate ledger able to become gate input without the confirmation boundary promised at docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:331. Severity: high.

docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:176 The Normal Story Path still runs milestone_ledger_set and ledger sizing before understanding_set and intent_collision_set, which contradicts the new candidate-ledger/confirmed-ledger lifecycle and can make a pre-collision candidate ledger look gate-consumed. severity: high
